name: Run DISM CheckHealth
description: Checks the Windows component store for corruption without performing repairs, serving as a quick diagnostic step when updates or system features fail.

description_i18n.en: Checks the Windows component store for corruption without performing repairs, serving as a quick diagnostic step when updates or system features fail.
description_i18n.de: Prüft den Windows-Komponentenspeicher auf Beschädigungen ohne Reparatur durchzuführen. Dies dient als schneller Diagnose-Schritt bei fehlgeschlagenen Updates oder Systemfunktionen.
description_i18n.fr: Vérifie si le magasin de composants Windows est corrompu sans effectuer de réparation, servant d'étape rapide de diagnostic lorsque les mises à jour ou fonctionnalités système échouent.

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Executes the DISM command with the /CheckHealth flag to inspect system integrity The operation runs once and does not alter persistent settings or modify any files
